The recipe is salisbury-steak-BURGERS and the line is '6 x 71 g large roll', i.e. the burger-bun purchase; a kaiser roll is a style of sandwich/burger roll, same food and same form as the hamburger-buns purchase, and no recipe need for the kaiser variant's macros or price is stated — a style name is not a variant. The string 'kaiser' appears nowhere in any of the three id namespaces or the feed, and dinner-rolls (the dossier's near row) is the wrong purchase: its includes are dinner/hawaiian/brown-and-serve rolls, the small-roll form, not a 71 g burger roll.
